words.meaning: An overwhelming state of intense happiness, elation, and well-being.
words.sentence1: She was filled with an uncontrollable euphoria after crossing the marathon finish line. (She was filled with an uncontrollable euphoria after crossing the marathon finish line.)
words.sentence2: The sudden rush of euphoria left him beaming with joy for hours. (The sudden rush of euphoria left him beaming with joy for hours.)

words.meaning: A deep and poignant yearning, desire, or longing.
words.sentence1: Sentia un profundo anhelo de volver a su tierra natal tras tantos anos. (He felt a deep yearning to return to his homeland after so many years.)
words.sentence2: Su mirada silenciosa reflejaba el anhelo de volver a ver a sus viejos amigos. (Her silent gaze reflected the longing to see her old friends again.)

words.meaning: A sudden tremor or shiver caused by strong emotion, excitement, or awe.
words.sentence1: Un frisson d'excitation la traversa des les premieres notes de la symphonie. (A shiver of excitement ran through her from the very first notes of the symphony.)
words.sentence2: Il ressentit un leger frisson en entendant cette voix familiere dans l'obscurite. (He felt a slight thrill hearing that familiar voice in the dark.)

words.meaning: A profound feeling of emotional safety, warmth, comfort, and protection.
words.sentence1: In den Armen ihrer Grossmutter empfand das Kind stets eine tiefe Geborgenheit. (In its grandmother's arms, the child always felt a deep sense of security and warmth.)
words.sentence2: Das knisternde Kaminfeuer schuf an diesem sturmischen Abend ein Gefuehl wohliger Geborgenheit. (The crackling fireplace created a feeling of cozy security on that stormy evening.)

words.meaning: A poignant, bittersweet sorrow or heartache mixed with longing.
words.sentence1: Yuuhi o mitsumete iru to, mune no oku ni setsunasa ga hirogatta. (Watching the setting sun, a bittersweet sadness spread deep in my chest.)
words.sentence2: Kono furui uta o kiku tabi ni, natsukashisa to setsunasa ga komiagete kuru. (Every time I hear this old song, feelings of nostalgia and poignant ache surge up.)

words.meaning: An intense, sweet-painful emotional ache, yearning, or consumption of the heart.
words.sentence1: Ascoltare quella melodia le provoco uno struggimento indescrivibile e dolce. (Listening to that melody caused her an indescribable, sweet yearning.)
words.sentence2: C'era un sottile struggimento nei suoi occhi mentre salutava la persona amata. (There was a subtle, poignant heartache in his eyes as he said goodbye to his beloved.)

words.meaning: A gentle state of sorrow, melancholy, or heavy-hearted sadness.
words.sentence1: Tade yanshen zhong toulu chu yisi nan-yi-yan-yu de youchou. (Her eyes revealed a faint touch of unspeakable melancholy.)
words.sentence2: Lianmian de qiuyu zongshi rongyi gouqi renmen xin di de youchou. (The continuous autumn rain always easily stirs up melancholy in people's hearts.)

words.meaning: A thrilling flutter of the heart, butterflies, or nervous anticipation.
words.sentence1: Geunyeoreul mannareo ganeun gil-eun eonjena gibun joeun seolleim-euro gadeukhaetda. (The path on the way to meet her was always filled with pleasant heart-fluttering excitement.)
words.sentence2: Cheot yeohaeng-eul apdugo maeumsog-e keun seolleim-i pieonassda. (Anticipating the first journey, a great flutter of excitement blossomed in my heart.)

words.meaning: Deeply thrilled, emotionally touched, or excitedly moved.
words.sentence1: Neang mean arom rompheuk chea khlang pel ban chuob koat vinh. (She felt profoundly thrilled and excited when she met him again.)
words.sentence2: Krom karngar teang-os khum chet ning rompheuk cheamuoy choy-chomneas nih. (The whole team felt joyful and thrilled by this victory.)

words.meaning: A tender feeling of longing, yearning, or missing someone deeply.
words.sentence1: Hy het 'n diep verlange na sy ou tuiste en familie ervaar. (He experienced a deep longing for his old home and family.)
words.sentence2: Die stilte van die nag het haar soete verlange na vervloe dae laat groei. (The quietness of the night made her sweet yearning for bygone days grow.)
